items.summary: Add an auto-scroll toggle button in the ShortSport page at the bottom-left area, positioned between the share and comment buttons. The toggle must not overlap any video content or other UI elements. When enabled, the feed should automatically scroll to the next video once the current video finishes playing.

Remove the zoom/crop effect from ShortSport videos so each video renders at its original aspect ratio and size without being cropped or scaled up. Ensure the post creator's username, profile avatar, and the video caption are fully visible and not hidden behind or beneath the video.
